name: wistia
description: Wistia modern API MCP server with 169 tools for media, folders, captions, channels, webinars, sharing, analytics and uploads.
long_description: 86 reads and 83 confirmed writes. Private scoped Bearer access; feature permissions and shared quota apply. Generated access credentials save only to private local files. Some operations may incur charges.

api_token.title: Wistia API Bearer token
api_token.description: Private scoped token from Account Settings > API; leave empty for token_file.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute regular owner-only token file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed writes
allow_destructive.description: If disabled, refuse all 83 mutations even when confirmed.
